entries.what: Labor Day: no school. Grace sleeps in a bit, then takes Corazón and Isabel to the Delgado Park picnic, where she watches the bandstand and ignores the grading pile.
entries.outcome: A quiet family day; the grading waits.

entries.what: Afternoon at home: Grace waters the calamansi and tomato pots and fills in the fridge calendar with Ramón's on-days.
entries.outcome: The week's logistics are mapped out.

entries.what: Evening: watches the teleserye with Corazón at 9 and skims the Unit 1 quiz plan.
entries.outcome: Quiz plan set for Friday.

entries.what: Arrives at 7:20 to beat the Vinca line, teaches periods 1, 2 and 3 in B12 with Unit 1 measurement review.
entries.outcome: Smooth lab-safety review, with Dulce's period quiet and attentive.

entries.what: Prep period 4: Grace eats leftover rice and ulam in B12 and runs Eli's extended-time test.
entries.outcome: Test finished, lunch eaten at last.

entries.what: Teaches periods 5 and 6, then collects and grades lab-safety sheets at the kitchen table.
entries.outcome: Sheets are half graded.

entries.what: Wednesday classes; Grace and Dana trade notes on sharing B12 shelf space and lab prep.
entries.outcome: The shelves are split.

entries.what: Science Olympiad co-advising 3:15-4:30 in B12 with a few early signups.
entries.outcome: Eight students signed up.

entries.what: Evening: refreshes her back-to-school night slides and asks Isabel about her day; the talk stays short.
entries.outcome: Slides done; Isabel retreats to her room.

entries.what: Eats lunch in B12 with Dana, who vents about her principal evaluations.
entries.outcome: Grace listens and shares a few tips.

entries.what: Back-to-School Night, 6-8 p.m.: Grace presents the chemistry syllabus, late-lab policy and lab safety to parents.
entries.outcome: A good turnout; parents ask about retakes.

entries.what: Home at 8:30; Corazón has saved dinner, and Grace eats it standing at the counter.
entries.outcome: Early bedtime.

entries.what: Fills in the weekly absence form by hand from the gradebook and turns it in at 3:30.
entries.outcome: Submitted on time, with muttering about forms.

entries.what: Grace gives the Unit 1 quiz in periods 5 and 6 and hands out the study guide for next week.
entries.outcome: Quizzes collected.

entries.what: Friday night: skips the Egrets opener because of the grading, while Isabel goes to the game with Nadia.
entries.outcome: Quiet house, a few quizzes marked.

entries.what: Saturday morning groceries at Ruiz Family Market, then conchas and rolls from Panadería Las Hermanas.
entries.outcome: Fridge stocked and bread bought.

entries.what: Afternoon: cleans the garage shelf where Ramón's carburetor parts sit and sighs.
entries.outcome: A truce; the parts stay for now.

entries.what: Evening: Isabel and Grace bicker briefly over a late curfew text.
entries.outcome: Isabel gets home by 10.

entries.what: Tagalog Mass at 9 with Corazón at Our Lady of the Marsh, then lunch and Sunday sinigang.
entries.outcome: Peaceful morning.

entries.what: Grading at the kitchen table: Grace redesigns the density lab with household substitutes so it costs under $40 for all five sections.
entries.outcome: A cheap lab ready for the week, with the budget stretched.

entries.what: Evening chat with the assistant: she drafts a gentle, encouraging note to a struggling third-period student, then asks for a firm list of rules to tape to Isabel's door about phone use after 11.
entries.outcome: The student note is sent; the rules list is printed.
